summary: Created to hold the foley app-integration work that MPI-520 explicitly excludes ('Foley as its own op ... is NOT part of this card'). Ships as a Flow per project_ltx_workflows_land_as_flows - no ModelDef, no dep entries. Opens BLOCKED on MPI-531 because FlowStepField today is one row of select|button|toggle and cannot express this flow's controls, so authoring it now would mean a new JS uiComponent that MPI-531 item 4 then has to port. Also takes over the foley-mode vs voice-mode product decision, which the MPI-4 handoff had parked on MPI-520 - the wrong card, since MPI-520 excludes foley.
Folded into umbrella MPI-552 by the project-refresh consolidation sweep.
